description.text: Fees: for the first two weeks is RMB 1600, and RMB 400 increment per each extra week of training. You could join the long-term Chinese language learning program for short-term study in the middle of the class. The duration is decided by you. Below are the courses for each program. Compulsory Courses for Elementary Chinese I Comprehensive Chinese I, Chinese Converstion I, Chinese Listening I Compulsory Courses for Elementary Chinese II Comprehensive Chinese II, Chinese Converstion II, Chinese Listening II Compulsory Courses for Intermediate Chinese I Comprehensive Chinese III, Chinese Converstion III, Chinese Listening III, Chinese Reading I Compulsory Courses for Intermediate Chinese II Comprehensive Chinese IV, Chinese Converstion IV, Chinese Listening IV, Chinese Reading II Compulsory Courses for Advanced Chinese I Comprehensive Chinese V, Chinese Converstion V, Impoving Chinese I, Chinese Reading and Writing I Compulsory Courses for Advanced Chinese II Comprehensive Chinese VI, Chinese Converstion VI, Impoving Chinese II, Chinese Reading and Writing II Selective Courses for the 6 Programs Martical Arts, Calligraphy, Paper-cut, Chinese Ethnic Dances

duration.text: The Short-term Chinese Training Program at Chongqing Normal University is a 2 Weeks long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 111 USD/per week ￥ 800 CNY/per week

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant.
